'''Ganaang Spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teagan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
